source_construct.description: A later public formalisation emphasizing that persistence is a predicate on typed histories and that endpoint-state observation can be insufficient for identity classification.
source_construct.source_location: PETRONUS Research Log entry dated 2026-07-19; full source freeze pending.

transformation: The c corpus already distinguishes archive, replay, resume, fork and continuity through Beacon and Continuity Bundle. The external work is used only to sharpen a paired endpoint-equal fixture and an explicit snapshot-insufficiency test.
preserved_properties: history can carry distinctions that an endpoint snapshot erases
insufficient observation must lower the verdict
rejected_properties: foreign terminology as canonical c vocabulary
mapping_failures: the external construct does not contain the accountable human anchor a or the full c = a + b formation relation

terminology_substitutions.reason: Preserves native Beacon and Continuity Bundle vocabulary.
Avoids importing a second resource ontology where L4 already exists.

claim_ceiling: This intake record supports only the claim that the later external paper sharpened a test surface. It does not establish derivation, dependency, priority over c, or transfer of ontology.
